title: Auto Shop — Michael Gray's vanished salvage team and mechanical debris

actions.title: SMOKEY'S — 11/01 PARTS REQUEST
pages:
11/01 — signed out by Michael Gray.
Team: June, Terry, Cole, Ellis.
Need two tires, battery, brake components, belts and oil.
Red sedan if intact. Back before dark.
This is a request, not a confirmation of any return.
actions.purpose: Копия заявки Майкла 1 ноября: прямая сюжетная связь мастерской с Smokey’s.

actions.title: JUNE — GREASE-STAINED NOTES
pages:
November first.
The service lift doesn't sound right. Someone's been using it without checking the lock.
Found a charged battery? Not yet.
Michael says get the belts first.
The front office radio only hisses.
We should have turned around before the light failed.
actions.purpose: Последние записи Джун о неисправном подъёмнике и отсутствии исправной батареи.

actions.title: AUTO SHOP — UNFINISHED SALVAGE
pages:
Shop floor tally — 11/01.
Tires: not loaded.
Battery: uncertain.
Belts: one worn.
Brakes: spare parts on the floor.
Oil: found.
There were five of us when we walked in.
This is not a delivery receipt.
actions.purpose: Незавершённая ведомость деталей открыто лежит на рабочем столе у ремонтного бокса.

actions.title: COLE — SCRATCHED CARD
pages:
Couldn't get the north bay open.
Terry went to the service door.
Michael called everyone back.
The front passage is blocked.
If this reaches Smokey's: we did try to come home.
actions.purpose: Оставленное Коулом сообщение о заблокированном выходе и попытке возвращения.
